name: crystal_extension_list
description: Discover and list extensions across the 3-tier scoping cascade (host, cave, crystal) including embedded Scala Native modules and declarative/executable drop-ins.

crystal_id.description: Optional crystal ID to inspect crystal-scoped extensions and state

scope.description: Filter by scope: host, cave, or crystal

json_output.description: Return raw JSON manifest array instead of formatted summary (default: false)
